title: Celestial Film Collision
description: A surreal scene of a woman in a flowing green dress caught mid-fall on a black and white checkered floor, entangled with a mechanical film projector that is actively projecting light. A carousel horse leaps through the chaos as film reels and strips scatter across the floor, with cherubs floating in a starry night sky above an ocean visible through ornate golden frames.
prompt: A dramatic surreal painting of a woman in an emerald green dress falling dramatically while entangled with a complex mechanical film projector that is shooting a beam of light, a golden carousel horse leaping through the scene, film strips and reels scattered across a black and white checkered floor, two cherubs floating in a starry night sky with ocean visible behind ornate golden frames, chaotic yet cinematic composition, classical painting style with modern elements
